item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity is easy to misread. Compare the numbers the listing states, and check what they mean for your food. Working title — hypothesis, not a product claim.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Cleaning and storage often decide whether a small appliance gets used. Check them before you buy. Working title — hypothesis, not a product claim.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Many functions can mean more to learn and more parts to store. Decide which functions you will use before you compare. Working title — hypothesis, not a product claim.
